<!-- Author: Kunru Song -->

This report estimates and diagnoses the prespecified primary 12-node mlVAR. It uses
one global 90-occasion sequence per participant, retains overnight transitions,
and estimates orthogonal person-specific temporal and contemporaneous random
effects. It creates no network table or figure; those belong to S5.3 and S5.4.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  collapse = FALSE, comment = NA
)

required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "knitr", "lme4", "Matrix", "mlVAR", "rmarkdown", "tibble"
)
available <- vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
if (!all(available)) {
  stop("Missing required R packages: ", paste(names(available)[!available], collapse = ", "))
}

report_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
report_directory <- if (length(report_file) == 1L && file.exists(report_file)) {
  dirname(normalizePath(report_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
} else getwd()
helper_candidates <- c(
  file.path(report_directory, "S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis", "S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R"),
  file.path(dirname(getwd()), "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis", "S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R")
)
helper_file <- helper_candidates[file.exists(helper_candidates)][1L]
if (is.na(helper_file)) stop("Could not locate S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R")
source(helper_file, encoding = "UTF-8")

project_root <- locate_project_root(dirname(helper_file))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

input_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis", "dat_step5_mlvar.rda"
)
result_file <- file.path(
  project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis", "fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar.rda"
)

stopifnot(file.exists(input_file), file.exists(helper_file))
dir.create(dirname(result_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load and validate the S5.1 entry

```{r load-data}
dat_step5_mlvar <- load_single_object(input_file, "dat_step5_mlvar")
node_names <- dat_step5_mlvar$node_map$node

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(dat_step5_mlvar),
    c("prompt", "node_map", "layout", "scaling", "sample_audit", "diagnostics", "provenance")
  ),
  length(node_names) == 12L,
  nrow(dat_step5_mlvar$prompt) == 18810L,
  sum(dat_step5_mlvar$prompt$lag1_complete) == 16598L,
  identical(
    dat_step5_mlvar$provenance$overnight_rule,
    "Primary model retains overnight transitions; no exclusion sensitivity planned"
  )
)

model_data <- dat_step5_mlvar$prompt |>
  dplyr::select(Name_ID, occasion, dplyr::all_of(node_names)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID, occasion) |>
  as.data.frame()

stopifnot(
  nrow(model_data) == 18810L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$Name_ID) == 209L,
  !anyNA(model_data[c("Name_ID", "occasion")]),
  !anyDuplicated(model_data[c("Name_ID", "occasion")]),
  all(tapply(model_data$occasion, model_data$Name_ID, function(x) identical(x, 1:90)))
)

input_audit <- data.frame(
  scheduled_rows = nrow(model_data),
  participants = dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$Name_ID),
  complete_12_node_occasions = sum(stats::complete.cases(model_data[node_names])),
  expected_usable_lag1_rows = sum(dat_step5_mlvar$prompt$lag1_complete),
  s5_1_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_file)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(input_audit)
```

# Model specification and estimation

`orthogonal` sets random-effect covariances to zero but retains every fixed
network edge and person-specific random-slope variance. `scale = TRUE` applies
global standardization; `scaleWithin = FALSE` person-mean centers lagged
predictors without dividing by person-specific SDs. The explicit global
`occasion` beep and absent `dayvar` retain the evening-to-next-day lag.

```{r fit-primary, cache=TRUE}
model_specification <- data.frame(
  argument = c(
    "vars", "idvar", "beepvar", "dayvar", "lags", "estimator",
    "temporal", "contemporaneous", "scale", "scaleWithin",
    "na.rm", "full_detrend", "overnight_exclusion_sensitivity"
  ),
  value = c(
    paste(node_names, collapse = ", "), "Name_ID", "occasion", "Not supplied",
    "1", "lmer", "orthogonal", "orthogonal", "TRUE", "FALSE",
    "TRUE", "FALSE", "Not planned"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

set.seed(52102L)
requested_cores <- min(13L, parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE))
fit_start <- Sys.time()
primary_model <- mlVAR::mlVAR(
  data = model_data,
  vars = node_names,
  idvar = "Name_ID",
  beepvar = "occasion",
  lags = 1,
  estimator = "lmer",
  temporal = "orthogonal",
  contemporaneous = "orthogonal",
  nCores = requested_cores,
  verbose = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE,
  scaleWithin = FALSE,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  full_detrend = FALSE
)
fit_end <- Sys.time()

timing <- data.frame(
  started = format(fit_start, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  finished = format(fit_end, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  elapsed_seconds = as.numeric(difftime(fit_end, fit_start, units = "secs")),
  requested_cores = requested_cores,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(model_specification)
knitr::kable(timing, digits = 2)
```

# Mixed-model and network diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
names(primary_model$output$temporal) <- node_names
names(primary_model$output$contemporaneous) <- node_names

temporal_diagnostics <- lmer_diagnostic_table(
  primary_model$output$temporal, node_names, "Temporal/between"
)
contemporaneous_diagnostics <- lmer_diagnostic_table(
  primary_model$output$contemporaneous, node_names, "Contemporaneous"
)
model_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  temporal_diagnostics, contemporaneous_diagnostics
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    boundary_singularity_message = grepl(
      "boundary (singular) fit", convergence_message, fixed = TRUE
    ),
    nonboundary_convergence_message = nzchar(convergence_message) &
      !boundary_singularity_message
  )

fixed_effect_covariance <- list(
  temporal = stats::setNames(
    lapply(primary_model$output$temporal, stats::vcov), node_names
  ),
  contemporaneous = stats::setNames(
    lapply(primary_model$output$contemporaneous, stats::vcov), node_names
  )
)

matrices <- extract_mlvar_matrices(primary_model)
validate_network_matrix(matrices$temporal, node_names, symmetric = FALSE)
validate_network_matrix(matrices$contemporaneous, node_names, symmetric = TRUE)
validate_network_matrix(matrices$between, node_names, symmetric = TRUE)

spectral_radius <- matrix_spectral_radius(t(matrices$temporal))
distress_between_correlation <-
  dat_step5_mlvar$diagnostics$distress_between_correlation
distress_between_eigenvalues <- eigen(
  distress_between_correlation, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE
)$values

network_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  diagnostic = c(
    "Rows used by mlVAR augmented data",
    "Participants used",
    "Temporal models",
    "Contemporaneous models",
    "Models with optimizer code != 0",
    "Models with boundary-singularity messages",
    "Models with nonboundary convergence messages",
    "Models singular at 1e-4",
    "Models singular at 1e-6",
    "Models with nonfinite fixed effects",
    "Fixed temporal spectral radius",
    "Minimum eigenvalue of Distress person-mean correlation",
    "Condition number of Distress person-mean correlation"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(primary_model$data),
    dplyr::n_distinct(primary_model$data$Name_ID),
    length(primary_model$output$temporal),
    length(primary_model$output$contemporaneous),
    sum(model_diagnostics$optimizer_code != 0L),
    sum(model_diagnostics$boundary_singularity_message),
    sum(model_diagnostics$nonboundary_convergence_message),
    sum(model_diagnostics$singular_1e4),
    sum(model_diagnostics$singular_1e6),
    sum(!model_diagnostics$finite_fixed_effects),
    spectral_radius,
    min(distress_between_eigenvalues),
    kappa(distress_between_correlation)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

fatal_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  criterion = c(
    "All 24 node-wise mixed models returned",
    "All models used the exact 16,598 lag-1 rows",
    "All 209 participants retained",
    "No nonzero optimizer termination code",
    "No nonboundary lme4 convergence message",
    "All fixed effects finite",
    "All three network matrices finite",
    "Contemporaneous and between matrices symmetric",
    "Fixed temporal system has spectral radius below one"
  ),
  passed = c(
    nrow(model_diagnostics) == 24L,
    all(model_diagnostics$observations == 16598L),
    all(model_diagnostics$groups == 209L),
    all(model_diagnostics$optimizer_code == 0L),
    all(!model_diagnostics$nonboundary_convergence_message),
    all(model_diagnostics$finite_fixed_effects),
    all(vapply(
      matrices[c("temporal", "contemporaneous", "between")],
      function(x) all(is.finite(x)), logical(1)
    )),
    isTRUE(all.equal(matrices$contemporaneous, t(matrices$contemporaneous), tolerance = 1e-8)) &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(matrices$between, t(matrices$between), tolerance = 1e-8)),
    is.finite(spectral_radius) && spectral_radius < 1
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(network_diagnostics, digits = 6)
knitr::kable(model_diagnostics, digits = 6)
knitr::kable(fatal_diagnostics)
if (!all(fatal_diagnostics$passed)) {
  print(fatal_diagnostics)
  stop("S5.2 fatal diagnostic gate failed")
}
```

Singular random-effect fits and boundary variance estimates are reported as model diagnostics. They do not by themselves prompt changes to a finite, converged orthogonal fixed network.
A fixed-slope comparison is considered only if the model fails the checks above.

# Save and disk-reload the canonical fitted object

```{r save-result}
package_versions <- data.frame(
  package = c("mlVAR", "lme4", "Matrix", "R"),
  version = c(
    as.character(utils::packageVersion("mlVAR")),
    as.character(utils::packageVersion("lme4")),
    as.character(utils::packageVersion("Matrix")),
    paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = ".")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

provenance <- list(
  input_file = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/dat_step5_mlvar.rda",
  input_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_file)),
  generating_script = "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis/S5_2_PrimarymlVAR.Rmd",
  helper_file = "Step_5_mlVAR_Network_Analysis/S5_0_mlVARHelpers.R",
  helper_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(helper_file)),
  fitted = timing$finished,
  missing_handling = paste(
    "mlVAR na.rm=TRUE; lag construction on 90-row scaffold; complete",
    "current-plus-lag augmented rows; no Kalman filtering/FIML/imputation"
  ),
  overnight_rule = "Retained through global occasion beep; no exclusion sensitivity planned",
  storage_rule = paste(
    "Canonical RDA retains mlVAR fixed/random result arrays, analyzed data,",
    "residuals, inputs, and complete diagnostic tables; the 24 full lmer",
    "objects are removed after diagnostics to avoid environment-heavy serialization"
  )
)

compact_model <- primary_model
compact_model$output <- NULL

fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar <- list(
  model = compact_model,
  model_specification = model_specification,
  input_audit = input_audit,
  timing = timing,
  model_diagnostics = model_diagnostics,
  fixed_effect_covariance = fixed_effect_covariance,
  network_diagnostics = network_diagnostics,
  fatal_gate = fatal_diagnostics,
  package_versions = package_versions,
  provenance = provenance
)

save(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar, file = result_file, version = 2)
rm(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar)
fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar <- load_single_object(
  result_file, "fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar"
)

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar),
    c(
      "model", "model_specification", "input_audit", "timing",
      "model_diagnostics", "fixed_effect_covariance", "network_diagnostics", "fatal_gate",
      "package_versions", "provenance"
    )
  ),
  inherits(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model, "mlVAR"),
  is.null(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$output),
  length(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$fixed_effect_covariance$temporal) == 12L,
  length(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$fixed_effect_covariance$contemporaneous) == 12L,
  all(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$fatal_gate$passed),
  identical(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$temporal, "orthogonal"),
  identical(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$beepvar, "occasion"),
  identical(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$dayvar, "DAY"),
  isTRUE(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$scaled),
  identical(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$scaleWithin, FALSE)
)

result_audit <- data.frame(
  output = "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis/fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar.rda",
  object = "fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar",
  bytes = file.info(result_file)$size,
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(result_file)),
  reload_passed = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(package_versions)
knitr::kable(result_audit)
```

```{r validate-fit, include=FALSE}
s5_2_acceptance <- rbind(
  fatal_diagnostics,
  data.frame(
    criterion = c(
      "Locked orthogonal temporal and contemporaneous settings",
      "Global occasion beep and no supplied day boundary",
      "Global scaling without person-specific SD scaling",
      "Full lmer objects summarized then removed from canonical RDA",
      "Sole-object fitted RDA disk reload"
    ),
    passed = c(
      identical(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$temporal, "orthogonal"),
      identical(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$beepvar, "occasion") &&
        identical(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$dayvar, "DAY"),
      isTRUE(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$scaled) &&
        identical(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$input$scaleWithin, FALSE),
      is.null(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model$output) &&
        nrow(fit_s5_2_primary_mlvar$model_diagnostics) == 24L,
      file.exists(result_file)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

stopifnot(all(s5_2_acceptance$passed))
```
